features: Vacuum cleaner attachment are suitable for most standard size vacuum hoses. The blue part is removable for smaller or larger hoses
These GIB cleaningtool vacuum cleaner attachment do not fit for Dyson and do not fit for Hoover brands vacuum cleaner
The vacuum cleaner attachments are suitable for hose or wand with 1.22" (31mm) or 1.3" outside diameter. Please check the diameter of your vacuum cleaner hose or wand.
All Vacuum parts are made of good quality material. They are usable in a long time
These accessory are flexible.You can use these vacuum attachments to clean any part of your home, such as : Keyboard, any gaps, shutter, sofa, vent, drawer, car, pet dust, and so on
